name: Orcières Merlette 1850
description: Orcières embodies the strength and grandeur of vast Alpine landscapes, infused with the warmth and exceptional sunshine of the South. Perched at an altitude of 1,850 meters at the gateway to Écrins National Park, the resort’s ski area rises to 2,725 meters, offering breathtaking views of the most magnificent peaks in the Écrins range. Holder of the "Famille Plus" label, Orcières Merlette 1850 provides accommodation, services, and facilities perfectly suited to families.
